raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (business date 2026-01-18) was delivered twice, at 02:00 and 05:00 ingest_ts: 666 rows, or 333 txn_ids × 2. The silver step does not deduplicate on txn_id, so all 318 POSTED transactions for that date appear twice in silver_transactions and every gold table is inflated. The two copies are identical apart from ingest_ts, so keeping one row per txn_id (the latest ingest) restores correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
